0000.name: rom_header
0000.comment: 55AA option ROM signature, size 30h*512 = 24 KB. Lives at E800:0000 at runtime (system BIOS far-calls E800:0010 etc).

0003.name: init_stub
0003.comment: Option ROM init entry: RETF - nothing to do at scan time

0010.name: api_entry_10
0010.comment: Far-callable entry table (each is call near ; retf). Called from system BIOS at F000:98F9 and jumped to from F000:5940 (POST start).

0024.name: api_entry_24
0024.comment: RETF stub; system BIOS far-jumps here from F000:5B01

0028.name: api_entry_28_apm
0028.comment: jmp near. System BIOS INT 15h handler far-jumps here when AH=53h (APM) - F000:BC70

002C.name: api_entry_2C
002C.comment: API 2Ch: jmp pm_record_service (SETUP/system BIOS record accessors, AH = sub-function, AL = record).

0030.name: api_entry_30_power_meter
0030.comment: API 30h: show the POWER METER overlay (system BIOS hot key Ctrl+Alt+F8 / Fn code 6Ah). Target show_power_meter.

0034.name: api_entry_34
0034.comment: Called via far pointer at F000:7B57 (SS:SP reset to 0000:FFFE first)

0038.name: api_entry_38_presence
0038.comment: API 38h: returns AX=DF00h (MISER signature/RAM segment); used by the system BIOS hot-key handlers as a presence check.

0050.name: credits_string
0050.comment: Developer credits: team leader, motherboard, power, sound, BIOS engineers.

00DA.name: apm_function_table
00DA.comment: 12 near pointers for INT 15h AH=53h AL=00h..0Bh (APM 1.0/1.1 functions). Called from the APM handler at 0139.

18CD.name: pm_subfn_dispatch_table
18CD.comment: 5 near pointers indexed by AH & 0Fh (0..4) - power-management record accessors (called from 190F with DS=DC00).

18F3.name: pm_subfn_dispatch
18F3.comment: DS := DC00h (MISER private RAM segment), SI := AH*2, DI := 8Eh + AL*8 (per-device record), then call table at 18CD.

177B.name: run_triple_table
177B.comment: For each (BX,DX,AX) triple at CS:SI until AX=FFFFh: call DI. Generic port/register programming walker.

2041.name: wait_refresh_toggles
2041.comment: Wait for 7 refresh-bit (port 61h bit 4) transitions - short delay.

2055.name: call_list_sum
2055.comment: Call each near pointer in NUL-terminated list at CS:SI, accumulating carry flags; returns AX = -(count of CF set).

373B.name: chain_prev_vector_058E
373B.comment: pushf + far call through saved far pointer at DS:058E (chains to the previous interrupt handler).

47FB.name: chain_prev_vector_ss10
47FB.comment: pushf + far call through far pointer at SS:0010.

5425.name: restart_post_resume_a
5425.comment: AX=0 -> port 8Dh (clear resume magic) then far jump to system BIOS POST entry F000:E05B.

5502.name: restart_post_resume_b
5502.comment: POST code 33h, AX=5678h -> port 8Dh (resume magic checked by post_start), far jump F000:E05B.

5476.name: call_vga_rom_init_c000
5476.comment: If 55AA at C000:0000, far call C000:0003 (re-init video ROM on resume).

548A.name: call_vga_rom_init_e000
548A.comment: If 55AA at E000:0000, far call E000:0003 (video ROM located at E000 in this image).

061D.name: call_system_setup
061D.comment: Far call F000:0100 = system BIOS SETUP entry.

1624.name: miser_post_hook
1624.comment: API 10h. POST code 90h; reads resume magic from port 8Dh (1234h / 5678h) to decide cold POST vs resume-from-suspend continuation.

1951.name: get_api_far_ptr
1951.comment: API 1Ch. Returns DX:AX = CS:002Ch (far pointer to the PM services entry).

1957.name: pm_services_body
1957.comment: Saves caller SS:SP in DC00:1425, switches to private stack DF80:07FF, runs sub_5172.

00CE.name: apm_int15_53_handler
00CE.comment: API 28h. DS=DC00; sub_00F2 implements INT 15h AH=53h (APM 1.x) functions; RETF 2 discards caller flags like an interrupt return.

18D7.name: pm_record_service
18D7.comment: API 2Ch. AH & 0Fh selects one of 5 record accessors (table 18CD); AH>=5 returns AH=81h/86h error.

0EAA.name: show_power_meter
0EAA.comment: API 30h body: open the private RAM window (chipset regs 200h/207h |= 0Fh), save the top 800 bytes of text page 0 (B800:0000) to C800:0000, draw the POWER METER box with INT 10h 13h (strings at 10EB/113B/118B/11DB, attribute 71h), read the battery gauge from port 1FFh (bits 1-5 -> 0..31, bar style 20h/30h/40h/50h by range), status line from chipset reg 12h bit0 ('Battery not installed') and reg 1 bit3 ('Running on AC power' / 'Running on battery power'), bar of 18h cells at row 1 col 37h, hold ~1000 x 65535 refresh toggles, restore the screen.

057A.name: os_environment_check
057A.comment: API 34h, the system BIOS hot-key path: INT 2Fh AX=1600h (Windows enhanced mode running -> refuse), INT 15h AX=1022h veto hook, INT 2Fh AX=5400h/5401h (a resident switcher protocol: told BX=0100h before and 0103h after SETUP when it answers BL=3); then chipset_200_207_bit2_set, pm_smi_inhibit_set, setup_popup_run, chipset_200_207_bit2_clear, pm_smi_inhibit_clear.

0A69.name: miser_presence_signature
0A69.comment: AX := DF00h. Doubles as the private RAM segment value.

17A4.name: miser_ram_init
17A4.comment: API 48h (called from system POST F000:6CF0). Writes signature AA55h,20h at DC00:0000 then sub_135E.

134A.name: open_private_ram
134A.comment: Best guess: enables access to the hidden DC00h/DF00h RAM window via chipset registers (always called before touching DC00:xxxx).

00F2.name: apm_dispatch
00F2.comment: INT 15h AH=53h body: AL>0Bh -> CF=1 (unsupported); else chipset reg 0Eh:=3E18h, open private RAM, call apm_function_table[AL], close RAM, chipset reg 0Eh:=3E10h.

1338.name: chipset_reg_set_bits
1338.comment: AX=chipset register index (ports 24h/26h), DX=bit mask to set.

1341.name: chipset_reg_clear_bits
1341.comment: AX=chipset register index, DX=bit mask to clear.

12E3.name: chipset_reg_read
12E3.comment: AX=chipset register index -> BX=value (best guess from call sites).

12F1.name: chipset_reg_test
12F1.comment: Test bits in a chipset register (loop in miser_post_hook waits for reg 1 bit 0).

5510.name: resume_b_body
5510.comment: Magic 5678h path: POST 55h, re-run miser_post_hook, POST 13h, then restart_post_resume_a.

538D.name: resume_a_body
538D.comment: Magic 1234h path: chipset reg 1 |= 7, POST EEh, read CMOS 0Fh, restore DMA page registers from table 5520 (6 pairs), continue resume from suspend.

5520.name: dma_page_restore_table
5520.comment: 6 (port, value) byte pairs for DMA page registers 81h.. restored on resume.

1FF7.name: cmos_read_field
1FF7.comment: AL = CMOS index, BL = bit mask: reads the byte and returns AH = (value & mask) shifted right to bit 0; ZF set when the field is zero. Used everywhere the module reads a SETUP option (PM level 42h, timeouts 44h/45h/4Ah/4Bh, display 5Eh, VersaPort 59h...).

3B40.name: pcmcia_card_detect
3B40.comment: Intel 82365SL-compatible PCMCIA controller at 3E0h/3E1h: reads Interface Status of socket A (index 01h) and socket B (index 41h) and tests bits 2-3 (card detect CD1/CD2). Used before suspend/resume decisions.

1A6F.name: pm_chipset_regs_from_config
1A6F.comment: Chipset reg 0Dh holds four 3-bit timeout fields: bits 10-12 := DC00:010B, bits 7-9 := 010C (System Sleep), bits 4-6 := 010D (Suspend), bits 1-3 := 010E (LCD Dim) - via chipset_reg_set_field.

0F70.name: battery_gauge_read
0F70.comment: Read port 1FFh twice until stable; level = (value >> 1) & 1Fh (0..31).

124D.name: str_battery_not_installed
124D.comment: 'Battery not installed   ' (24 chars) - POWER METER status line.

122B.name: battery_bar_glyphs
122B.comment: Cell pattern for the battery gauge bar (Empty .. Full).

02AB.name: apm_07_set_power_state
02AB.comment: BX must be 1 (all devices), CX = state <= 4. Requires DC00:000C bit 8 (connected) and bit 7 (PM enabled). Only CX=2 (suspend) is implemented: POST 71h/72h notifications (pm_event_notify), enter_suspend (sub_213D), flag bit 2 set, POST 70h. Other states -> error 04A9.

0389.name: apm_0A_get_power_status
0389.comment: BX must be 1. Returns BH = AC line (chipset reg 1 bit 3 -> 1 online / 0 offline), BL = battery status (FFh unknown when chipset reg 12h bit 0 says no battery; 2 = low when reg 0 bits 12-13 set; 1 = low when percentage <= 25; else 0 = high), CL = battery life % = ((port 1FFh & 3Fh) x 80) / 51.

040E.name: apm_0B_get_pm_event
040E.comment: Event word at DC00:000C (bit 7 = PM enabled gate). Battery-low detection: chipset reg 0 bits 12-13 and reg 9 bit 8, debounced 3 times via counter at DC00:000E -> sets event bit 4. Returns BX = 1 standby request, 2 suspend request, 3 normal resume, 4 critical resume, 5 battery low (lowest pending bit, then cleared); POST B1h; no event -> error 04B1.

04D0.name: pm_event_notify
04D0.comment: Notifies the state machine of the code in AL (POST codes 70h-72h, B1h are written to port 80h by the callers): best guess updates the DC00 event/state words and drives chipset registers.

213D.name: enter_suspend
213D.comment: Suspend state machine (APM set-power-state CX=2 and internal time-outs). Chipset reg 6 |= 4000h, reg 200h |= 1F00h; abort paths on reg 0 bit 13, reg 9 bit 7 / reg 12h bit 9 (lid/AC conditions); video off through INT 10h 5F50h/5F51h (chained), PICs masked (save_pic_masks_and_mask_all); pcmcia_card_detect - a card present aborts to 0E03; deep path at 2340: save chipset reg 6, PIC masks, CMOS index, program regs 1/6/9/0Ch/11h, set 0000:0472 = far pointer E800:2478 (resume vector used by post_cold_entry), save SS:SP at DC00:118/11A, copy 3000:FE00 (512 bytes) and 3000:8000 (8 bytes) into DC00:28C/48C, device power-down (sub_1520/sub_521E/sub_497F), finally chipset reg 1 := (reg1 & 1FFFh) | A000h and HLT.

04A9.name: apm_err_param
04A9.comment: AH = 60h (parameter out of range) / not implemented.

2478.name: resume_entry
2478.comment: Reached from the system BIOS post_cold_entry via ljmp [0040:0072] when chipset reg 1 bit 8 reports a resume: DS=DC00, restore SS:SP from DC00:118/11A, jmp resume_continue (153A).

153A.name: resume_continue
153A.comment: Resume continuation after resume_entry (restores devices, video, PIC masks, returns to the interrupted code).

25A0.name: save_pic_masks_and_mask_all
25A0.comment: DC00:123/124 := PIC1/PIC2 masks; mask all IRQs.

24F9.name: suspend_abort_restore
24F9.comment: Suspend could not complete (sub_274B failed): restore PIC masks, chipset regs 0Eh/1, CMOS index, reg 6, sub_29EF, flag DC00:111 := 1.

22D9.name: suspend_abort
22D9.comment: Common abort: DC00:494 := 0, chipset reg 11h := 200h, reg 1 |= F7h, sub_1A43, sub_199F.

22F7.name: standby_enter
22F7.comment: Light sleep: DC00:494 := 1, chipset reg 0Dh via sub_1309 (1C00h, BL=4), reg 3 |= 1, reg 1 &= ~1C00h.

1FEC.name: cmos_read
1FEC.comment: Read CMOS byte AL (port 70h index, 71h data) -> AH; AL preserved. (Earlier guess 'C&T extension register read' was wrong: the ports are 70h/71h.)

1FFE.name: cmos_write
1FFE.comment: Write AH to CMOS byte AL (ports 70h/71h).

07A6.name: install_activity_hooks
07A6.comment: If PM initialised (query_state_34): IVT 09h/10h/15h/16h/21h/33h := MISER handlers stored at DC00:28/2C/30/34/38/3C (keyboard, video, system services, keyboard services, DOS, mouse) - the activity monitors that reset the LCD/HDD/system timers. Also forces 40:1A = 40:1C (flush keyboard buffer).

0761.name: restore_original_vectors
0761.comment: Restore INT 21h and INT 33h from the copies saved at DC00:20/24 and INT 10h from 40:1A - undo of install_activity_hooks.

5684.name: std_find_partition
5684.comment: Save-to-disk: reset controller (sub_5738), INT 13h read MBR of drive 80h into SS:8Dh, check AA55h, scan the 4 partition entries for type A0h (PhoenixMISER); store start LBA (+8) at SS:50 and size (+0Ch) at SS:58, geometry heads/spt from the INT 41h table at SS:54/56; read the first two sectors of the partition through lba_to_chs and validate the good-space map (sub_5AFC). AX = 1..5 error code -> std_report_error.

5AC9.name: lba_to_chs_int13
5AC9.comment: ESI = LBA within the MISER partition -> CH/CL/DH for INT 13h using heads (SS:54) and sectors/track (SS:56) from the drive parameter table; ES:BX buffer.

5AFC.name: std_check_space_map
5AFC.comment: Validate the good-space-map sector at SS:8D: dword signature 54 69 6D 4F (TimO), byte 91 == 0, dword 95 == 0, and the 16-bit sum of the following FCh words must equal ~word 93. AX = 6 (map missing) or 7 (map corrupted) on failure.

5738.name: std_reset_disk
5738.comment: Unmask IRQ14/IRQ2, pulse 3F6h bit 2 (controller reset), INT 13h AH=09h init params and AH=11h recalibrate on drive 80h; POST codes AAh/BBh on failure.

57A1.name: std_report_error
57A1.comment: Print the save-to-disk error box for code AX (1 reset, 2 read, 3 write, 4 partition table, 5 no MISER partition, 6-9 space map/internal/out of space) with the 'Please power-off' advice.

2808.name: pm_state_dispatch
2808.comment: 16 near pointers indexed by the event code in chipset reg 1 bits 4-7 (pm_state_run): 0 pm_state_default, 1 pm_evt_enter_suspend_alias, 2 pm_evt_ack_only, 3 pm_enter_suspend_state, 4 pm_evt_standby_or_suspend_timeout, 5 pm_evt_activity_wakeup, 6 pm_evt_lcd_dim, 7 pm_evt_fn_hotkey, 8 pm_evt_system_sleep, 9/0Ah default, 0Bh pm_enter_suspend_state, 0Ch pm_evt_reinit_timeouts, 0Dh default, 0Eh pm_evt_resume_irqs, 0Fh default.

2009.name: cmos_write_field
2009.comment: AL = CMOS index, BL = mask, AH = new field value (right-aligned): shifts AH into the mask position and read-modify-writes the CMOS byte.

202E.name: extract_masked_field
202E.comment: AH &= BL, then shift AH right by the number of trailing zero bits of the mask; ZF = field is zero.

5581.name: cmos_test_field
5581.comment: DL = CMOS index, DH = mask: AL = masked field shifted to bit 0, ZF set when zero (same as cmos_read_field with the arguments in DX).

552C.name: reduced_resume_flag
552C.comment: ZF = (DF80:0030 == 0). Non-zero selects the short device-restore list (keyboard, floppy, serial only).

04FE.name: dev_init_list
04FE.comment: NUL-terminated list of near pointers run by call_list_sum from miser_post_hook (16AD) at PM init: pm_clear_494, ram_window_remap_test, pm_flags_reset, activity_counters_clear, cmos_diag_probe, hd_pm_init, floppy_pm_init, save_com_lpt_ports, kbdpm_module_name_copy, save_int6d_vector, config_records_init, hd_init_stub, ret, save_hooked_vectors.

051C.name: dev_suspend_list
051C.comment: Near pointers run (call_list_sum) when entering suspend (23FD): kbc_suspend_save, hd_suspend_standby, floppy_suspend, uart_lpt_suspend_save, pcmcia_suspend, lcd_suspend_off. The short list dev_suspend_list_short is used instead when CMOS 4Ch bit 4 is set.

052A.name: dev_resume_list
052A.comment: Near pointers run on resume (24D4): kbc_resume_restore, ret_09A8, pcmcia_resume_versaport, hd_resume, floppy_resume, uart_lpt_resume_restore, resume_platform_byte_reg3. dev_resume_list_short is used when reduced_resume_flag is non-zero.

054A.name: hd_init_stub
054A.comment: pusha; call hd_init_idle_timer; popa; ret (member of dev_init_list).

00C2.name: pm_flags_reset
00C2.comment: DC00:000C := 0100h (APM flags: connected bit only), DC00:000E := 0 (battery-low counter).

0688.name: save_hooked_vectors
0688.comment: Copies the original IVT entries of INT 09h, 16h, 10h, 15h, 21h, 33h to DC00:0010/1C/14/18/20/24 before the activity hooks are installed.

36F4.name: save_int6d_vector
36F4.comment: IVT entry 6Dh (the VGA BIOS's own INT 10h entry) -> DC00:058E; chain_prev_vector_058E calls the video BIOS directly through it.

38DE.name: save_com_lpt_ports
38DE.comment: Copies the four COM base addresses 40:00-07 to DC00:05C2 and the three LPT bases 40:08-0D to DC00:05EA.

390A.name: uart_lpt_suspend_save
390A.comment: For each COM port: save LCR (base+3) at DC00:05CA+4n, clear DLAB, save IER (base+1) at 05CB+4n and zero it, set DLAB and save divisor low/high at 05CC/05CD+4n, save MCR (base+4) at 05CE+4n. For each LPT: save control register (base+2) & 1Fh at 05F0+2n.

3985.name: uart_lpt_resume_restore
3985.comment: Reverse of uart_lpt_suspend_save: reprogram divisor, LCR, IER and MCR of each UART and the control register of each LPT from the saved copies.

2873.name: floppy_pm_init
2873.comment: DC00:0497 := equipment byte 40:10 bit 0 (floppy controller present).

2885.name: floppy_suspend
2885.comment: If a floppy is present: save chipset regs 81h/82h (the PicoPower shadow copies of the last DOR 3F2h and CCR 3F7h writes) at DC00:04A8/04AA, then DOR := 04h (controller enabled, motors off, DMA/IRQ gate off).

28AF.name: floppy_resume
28AF.comment: Re-programs DMA channel 2 (dma_ch2_reinit) then restores DOR 3F2h and CCR 3F7h from the high bytes of the saved shadow registers.

2975.name: dma_ch2_reinit
2975.comment: Writes 40h..43h to DMA1 mode register 0Bh (channels 0-3: single mode, verify) ... then DMA2 mode C0h (cascade) and unmask channel 4 via D4h. Restores the DMA controllers after a suspend.

299C.name: hd_pm_init
299C.comment: DC00:04AC := number of hard disks 40:75. If any: BL = idle timer count from hd_idle_count_from_cmos -> 04AD; from the INT 41h FDPT (0:104) save sectors/track (+0Eh) at 04AE and heads (+2) at 04AF; issue ATA E3h IDLE with the timer count (ide_cmd_with_count).

29D7.name: hd_suspend_standby
29D7.comment: If a hard disk is present: ATA E2h STANDBY with the timer count (spins the drive down before suspend).

29EF.name: hd_resume
29EF.comment: If a hard disk is present: ide_soft_reset, ATA 91h INITIALIZE DEVICE PARAMETERS (BH = sectors/track, BL = heads-1 from the saved FDPT fields), ATA E3h IDLE with the timer count; then hd_set_idle_timer.

2A1B.name: hd_standby_now
2A1B.comment: pusha; if a hard disk is present issue ATA E2h STANDBY with the CMOS-derived count; popa. Not referenced by the decoded code (spare entry).

2A31.name: ide_cmd_with_count
2A31.comment: AH = ATA command, BH = sector count (1F2h), BL = drive/head (1F6h). Waits for ready via the alternate status 3F6h before each write, issues the command, waits up to 5 polls for IRQ14 in the PIC2 IRR (OCW3 0Ah on A0h, bit 6), then reads status 1F7h to clear it.

2AAC.name: ide_wait_ready
2AAC.comment: Up to 5 reads of 3F6h until (status & C0h) == 40h (DRDY, not BSY).

2AC0.name: hd_init_idle_timer
2AC0.comment: dev_init_list member via hd_init_stub: if 40:75 says a disk is present, BL = hd_idle_count_from_cmos; if DC00:010F (PM level) is non-zero store it at 04AD; issue ATA E3h IDLE with that count and call hd_set_idle_timer.

2AED.name: hd_idle_count_from_cmos
2AED.comment: BL = ATA standby-timer count (units of 5 s) for the SETUP 'Hard Disk Sleep' value in CMOS 4Bh: 1->0Ch (1 min), 2->18h (2 min), 3->3Ch (5 min), 4->78h (10 min), 5->B4h (15 min), else 0. Returns 0 when CMOS 42h bits 0-1 (Power Management) = 0, or when it is 2 ('On For Battery') and chipset reg 1 bit 3 (AC adapter present) is clear.

2B59.name: hd_set_idle_timer
2B59.comment: Same CMOS 4Bh lookup as hd_idle_count_from_cmos, then writes the count to 1F2h and issues ATA E3h IDLE (drive spins down after the timer expires).

2BFE.name: hd_set_standby_timer
2BFE.comment: Same lookup, writes the count to 1F2h and issues ATA E2h STANDBY.

2828.name: pm_state_run
2828.comment: Saves the PIC masks (DC00:0495/0496), reads the event code from chipset reg 1 bits 4-7 (mask F0h), maps index BL (5 -> 0Bh when DC00:0494 is set) into pm_state_dispatch and calls the entry; restores the masks.

2860.name: pm_state_default
2860.comment: Chipset reg 6 |= 4000h, reg 1 |= F7h (default/no-op state entry).

199F.name: pm_timer_reload
199F.comment: Chipset reg 0 := 0788h (restarts the power-management timer, best guess).

19B1.name: pm_timer_check
19B1.comment: Battery-level check: reads chipset reg 0; when bit 13 (battery low) is set the level is DC00:0109, when bit 12 (critical) is also set the larger of 0109/010A; a level of 7 forces enter_suspend (the battery-low action configured through config records 4/5, CMOS 46h).

19F2.name: set_counter_107
19F2.comment: DC00:0107 := BL; pm_timer_reload. Config record 2 handler (CMOS 43h bits 3-5).

19FA.name: set_counter_108
19FA.comment: DC00:0108 := BL; pm_timer_reload. Config record 3 handler (CMOS 44h bits 3-5).

1A02.name: set_counter_109
1A02.comment: DC00:0109 := BL; pm_timer_reload. Config record 4 handler (CMOS 46h bits 0-2).

1A0A.name: set_counter_10A
1A0A.comment: DC00:010A := BL; pm_timer_reload. Config record 5 handler (CMOS 46h bits 3-5).

1A12.name: cmos_diag_probe
1A12.comment: DC00:010B-010D := 0, 010F := 1; if CMOS 0Eh bit 7 (RTC lost power) or CMOS 34h bit 7 is set, 010F := 0 (power management off after a CMOS loss); then pm_timeouts_apply.

1A43.name: pm_timeouts_apply
1A43.comment: Clears chipset reg 0Dh bits 1FFEh; if pm_level_active: DC00:0110 := 0, and when CMOS 44h bits 0-2 (System Sleep) are non-zero 0110 := 3 and 010C := 010D; then pm_chipset_regs_from_config.

1EC3.name: pm_level_active
1EC3.comment: CF=1 when DC00:010F (PM level from CMOS 42h) is 1 (On Always), or is 2 (On For Battery) and chipset reg 1 bit 3 (AC present) is clear (running on battery); CF=0 otherwise.

1309.name: chipset_reg_set_field
1309.comment: AX = register, DX = field mask, BL = value: read-modify-write of one chipset register field (value shifted into the mask).

1EE1.name: cfg_set_pm_level
1EE1.comment: Config record 0 (CMOS 42h bits 0-1): DC00:010F := BL, pm_timeouts_apply, pm_timer_reload.

1EEC.name: cfg_set_counter_10B
1EEC.comment: Config record 6 (CMOS 43h bits 0-2): DC00:010B := 7 (value forced), pm_timeouts_apply.

1EF6.name: cfg_set_system_sleep
1EF6.comment: Config record 7 (CMOS 44h bits 0-2, System Sleep): DC00:010C := BL, pm_timeouts_apply.

1EFE.name: cfg_set_suspend_timeout
1EFE.comment: Config record 8 (CMOS 45h bits 0-2, System Suspend): DC00:010D := BL, pm_timeouts_apply.

1F0B.name: cfg_set_lcd_dim
1F0B.comment: Config record 0Eh (CMOS 4Ah bits 0-2, LCD Dim): DC00:010E := BL, pm_timeouts_apply.

1F1D.name: pm_irq_reenable
1F1D.comment: PIC masks := B8h / 1Ch (IRQ0,1,2,6 and IRQ 8,9,13 enabled), then checks the PIC1 IRR; POST 61h on port 80h.

1874.name: config_records_init
1874.comment: Builds the 15 x 8-byte device/configuration records at DC00:008E from the ROM table config_records (17BD). Each ROM entry: record index, CMOS index, bit mask, handler pointer, N, N encoded values (list A), N raw values (list B). Record layout: +0 current CMOS field (cmos_read_field), +1 N, +2 handler, +4 -> list A, +6 -> list B. Afterwards pm_record_service AH=1 and AH=3 are run for records 0..0Eh, which calls every handler with the current setting.

17BD.name: config_records
17BD.comment: SETUP option -> PM binding table (see config_records_init). Records: 0 CMOS 42h bits0-1 Power Management -> cfg_set_pm_level; 1 4Eh bit0 -> set_counter_106; 2 43h bits3-5 -> set_counter_107; 3 44h bits3-5 -> set_counter_108; 4 46h bits0-2 -> set_counter_109; 5 46h bits3-5 -> set_counter_10A; 6 43h bits0-2 -> cfg_set_counter_10B; 7 44h bits0-2 System Sleep -> cfg_set_system_sleep (A: 0,6,0Ah,12h,1Ah,22h,32h,42h = 4*minutes+2 for Off/1/2/4/6/8/12/16 min; B: 0-7); 8 45h bits0-2 System Suspend -> cfg_set_suspend_timeout (A: 0,16h,2Ah,3Eh,52h,7Ah,A2h,F2h = Off/5/10/15/20/30/40/60 min); 0Ah 4Bh byte Hard Disk Sleep -> hd_init_idle_timer (A: 0,6,0Ah,16h,2Ah,3Eh; B: 0,0Ch,18h,3Ch,78h,B4h ATA timer counts); 0Ch 42h bit6 -> (ret); 0Dh 4Ch bit4 -> cfg_set_0C24; 0Eh 4Ah bits0-2 LCD Dim -> cfg_set_lcd_dim. FFh ends the table.

3712.name: resume_platform_byte_reg3
3712.comment: dev_resume_list member: restore_port1FF_from_cmos3F, then chipset reg 3 := 2EC0h (the value the system BIOS programs at POST, best guess).

385B.name: lcd_panel_off
385B.comment: Called from enter_suspend (21DF) and lcd_suspend_off: C&T extension register XR52 (3D6h/3D7h) bit 3 cleared (panel power, best guess: 0 = off), then CMOS 3Fh -> port 1FFh (platform byte, backlight/contrast bits).

3884.name: lcd_panel_on
3884.comment: If XR52 bit 3 is clear: clear chipset reg 200h bits 9/10, set XR52 bit 3 (panel power on), set reg 200h bits 9/10 again.

38CA.name: restore_port1FF_from_cmos3F
38CA.comment: CMOS 3Fh (platform configuration byte) -> port 1FFh, as post_53_platform_init does.

3825.name: display_device_apply
3825.comment: CMOS 5Eh bits 6-7 (SETUP 'Display Device' CRT/LCD/both) -> INT 10h AX=5F51h (BL = 0/1/2, BH = 1; 3 -> BX=0101h) through the saved video BIOS vector, then a 10000-tick delay.

3741.name: video_ext_12_9A_89
3741.comment: Calls the video BIOS with INT 10h AH=12h BL=9Ah, combines bits with the 3CCh (misc output) sync polarity, and writes back via AH=12h BL=89h. Both sub-functions are unimplemented in this C&T ROM (no-ops) - left over from another video BIOS.

3799.name: video_int10_12
3799.comment: INT 10h AH=12h with BL from caller, via chain_prev_vector_058E (the saved INT 6Dh).

3803.name: video_ext_12_89_from_cmos4C
3803.comment: CMOS 4Ch bits 6-7 -> table 3821 -> INT 10h AH=12h BL=89h (no-op in this video BIOS).

37EF.name: seq_clock_mode_12
37EF.comment: Sequencer register 06h := 12h with the index restored (C&T extension unlock/clocking, best guess).

0AC1.name: kbc_cmd_A7_disable_aux
0AC1.comment: KBC command A7h (disable auxiliary device) via kbc_send_command_nowait.

0AC7.name: kbc_cmd_A8_enable_aux
0AC7.comment: KBC command A8h (enable auxiliary device), then sub_0815.

0AD0.name: kbc_send_command_nowait
0AD0.comment: Spin (CX=0..FFFF) until 64h bit 1 (input buffer full) clears, then write AL to 64h.

09BD.name: kbd_set_leds_retry
09BD.comment: Up to 1000h attempts: EDh to 60h, wait for FAh ACK, then send the LED byte.

09E1.name: bda_B9_bit7_set
09E1.comment: 40:B9 |= 80h (keyboard flag byte; INT 16h in progress marker, best guess).

09F0.name: popup_int16_service
09F0.comment: Keyboard service used inside the pop-up (the BIOS INT 16h is not usable from the SMI context): AH=0 -> popup_wait_key_ascii, AH=1 -> ZF = key available (64h bit 0); RETF 2 (interrupt-style return, best guess installed as INT 16h while the pop-up runs).

0AEB.name: sb_dsp_speaker_off
0AEB.comment: Sound Blaster-compatible DSP at 220h: wait for write-ready (22Ch bit 7 clear, 4 tries) then DSP command D3h (speaker off) via sb_dsp_reset_wait_AA; finally writes FDh to 22Ch (vendor power-down command, best guess).

0B29.name: sb_dsp_reset
0B29.comment: DSP command EFh (vendor), reset via 226h (1 then 0) with POST codes F1h-F4h on port 80h, waits for AAh on 22Ah (data-available = 22Ch bit 6 here).

0B85.name: sb_dsp_reset_wait_AA
0B85.comment: Writes EFh to 22Ch, delays, waits for 22Ch bit 6, reads 22Ah and repeats until AAh is returned.

0BAC.name: sb_dsp_busy_check
0BAC.comment: BL = FFh when the DSP write buffer stays busy (22Ch bit 7) or bit 2 is set, else 0.

3B09.name: superio_read
3B09.comment: Super I/O configuration read: index AL -> 26Eh, value from 26Fh -> AH.

3B24.name: superio_write
3B24.comment: Super I/O configuration write: index AL -> 26Eh, value AH -> 26Fh (written twice).

3B7E.name: chipset_reg0E_bit8
3B7E.comment: BL = 0: set chipset reg 0Eh bit 8; else clear it.

3BAD.name: int70_rtc_alarm_handler
3BAD.comment: IRQ8 handler used while suspended: if DC00:05F7 is armed, INT 1Ah AH=01h sets the tick count from DC00:05F9/05FB, adds DC00:05F8 to the midnight counter 40:70, and clears the flag (private RAM opened/closed around the write).

3BE4.name: rtc_snapshot_date
3BE4.comment: Arms DC00:05F7 and stores the current date in binary: day -> 05FD, month -> 05FF, year + 100*century -> 0601 (rtc_read_date, BCD converted with AAM/AAD).

3C18.name: rtc_compute_elapsed_on_resume
3C18.comment: date_to_elapsed_days (-> DC00:05F8) and time_to_ticks (-> 05F9/05FB) so int70_rtc_alarm_handler can set the clock after a suspend.

3D44.name: rtc_read_date
3D44.comment: Waits for UIP (CMOS 0Ah bit 7) clear, reads CMOS 07h day -> DL, 08h month -> DH, 09h year -> CL, 32h century -> CH (all BCD), re-checks UIP.

3D75.name: rtc_read_time
3D75.comment: Waits for UIP clear, reads CMOS 00h/02h/04h seconds/minutes/hours (BCD).

3A4B.name: pcmcia_resume_versaport
3A4B.comment: 82365 Global Control (1Eh) := 02h, delay; then re-programs Super I/O registers 02h/03h/04h (26Eh/26Fh) according to CMOS 59h bits 0-1 (SETUP 'VersaPort Function': parallel / external floppy / EPP) and bit 2 (mode line).

2CA1.name: kbc_bda_segment
2CA1.comment: Word 0040h - segment of the BIOS data area (read via CS:).

2CA3.name: kbc_restore_offsets_ext
2CA3.comment: Word offsets from DC00:04C8 of saved bytes written back through kbc_ext_write_BD: 40h, 11h, 0Dh, 07h, 05h, 04h, 03h, FFFF end (used when the KBC has the extended RAM and the old firmware class).

2CA7.name: kbc_restore_offsets
2CA7.comment: Same list without the first two entries: 0Dh, 07h, 05h, 04h, 03h, FFFF.

2CB1.name: kbc_ram_read_cmds
2CB1.comment: KBC 'read RAM byte n' commands saved/restored: 24h,25h,26h,2Ah-2Fh,32h-3Fh (23 bytes, FFh end); +40h gives the matching write command 6xh.

2CC9.name: str_KeyboardPMSR
2CC9.comment: 'KeyboardPMSR' - module name copied to DC00:04B0 at init.

2CD9.name: kbdpm_module_name_copy
2CD9.comment: Copies str_KeyboardPMSR to DC00:04B0 (NUL-terminated). Member of dev_init_list.

2CFD.name: kbc_suspend_save
2CFD.comment: KeyboardPMSR save phase (dev_suspend_list). Progress trace words DC00:057F/0581/0583 get one bit per step. Steps: kbc_save_command_byte, kbc_probe_and_save_config, kbc_save_ram_bytes, kbc_save_password_or_reset, mouse_save_status, kbd_mouse_disable_scanning, kbc_save_ext_ram_80_FF, kbc_save_ram_regs_list, kbc_save_output_port, kbd_leds_off_and_powerdown. Save area DC00:04C0-057E.

2D32.name: kbc_save_command_byte
2D32.comment: Flush 60h; command 20h (read command byte) -> DC00:04C8 after ADh (disable keyboard) and A7h (disable aux).

2D52.name: kbc_probe_and_save_config
2D52.comment: LED state from 40:17 bits 4-6 -> 04C5; defaults 04D0 := LEDs | 20h (scan set 2 bit), 04D1 := 2Bh (typematic), 04C0/04C1/04C2 := 0; then the probe chain kbc_probe_phoenix_version .. kbc_classify.

2D98.name: kbc_probe_phoenix_version
2D98.comment: Command A1h (Phoenix MultiKey: read firmware version) -> 04C3 and 04C0 bit 7; command CAh (read KBC mode byte): bit 0 = PS/2 (aux) mode -> 04C5 bit 7.

2DE4.name: kbc_test_aux_interface
2DE4.comment: Command A9h (test aux interface); success -> 04C5 bit 7.

2E10.name: kbc_probe_ext_ram_read
2E10.comment: Command BAh (extended RAM read) answered -> 04C0 bit 6.

2E3C.name: kbc_test_ext_ram_rw
2E3C.comment: B9h read -> 04C6; B8h write of the complement; B9h read back and compare -> 04C0 bit 5 (extended RAM writable).

2E9B.name: kbc_read_version_config
2E9B.comment: Commands D5h/D6h (D7h/D8h when the aux port is present): version word -> 04C3 (default 2480h), config bytes -> 04C1/04C2 (defaults 73h/80h).

2F0F.name: kbc_classify
2F0F.comment: 04C1 bits 7/3/0 -> 04C0 bits 2/1/0; when the class is 1: version <= 155h -> 04C0 bit 4, <= 148h -> bit 3 (older firmware needs the extra restore steps).

2F76.name: kbc_save_ram_bytes
2F76.comment: kbc_ext_read_BC of indexes 1..0Ah (1..14h when 04C1 bit 5) -> DC00:04C9..; index 2Ah via kbc_ext_read_BA -> 04D8 when 04C0 bit 3.

2FBE.name: kbc_save_password_or_reset
2FBE.comment: With extended RAM: 9 bytes from index 04CE via kbc_ext_read_BA -> 04DF..04E7 (password buffer), index 1 & F7h written back with kbc_ext_write_BD. Otherwise kbc_keyboard_probe_FE.

2FFA.name: kbc_keyboard_probe_FE
2FFA.comment: Sends FEh (resend) to the keyboard; if it answers: 04C9 bit 3, self-test AAh, then command byte := saved | 10h (keyboard disabled) | 20h when an aux device exists.

3051.name: mouse_save_status
3051.comment: E9h (status request) via mouse_cmd: an E9h echo means wrap mode was active (04C5 bit 3; ECh resets it and the request is repeated); on FAh the three status bytes go to 04DC/04DD/04DE and 04C5 bit 4 is set. Defaults 00/02/64h.

30B6.name: kbd_mouse_disable_scanning
30B6.comment: F5h to the keyboard then ADh; with an aux device F5h via D4h then A7h.

30E8.name: kbc_save_ext_ram_80_FF
30E8.comment: 128 bytes of KBC extended RAM 80h-FFh via kbc_ext_read_BA -> DC00:04FF-057E (when 04C1 bit 5).

310E.name: kbc_save_ram_regs_list
310E.comment: KBC RAM bytes read with the commands in kbc_ram_read_cmds -> DC00:04E8-04FE.

3132.name: kbc_save_output_port
3132.comment: D0h read output port: keep bit 1 (A20), OR DDh -> 04C7; then D1h := DFh.

3156.name: kbd_leds_off_and_powerdown
3156.comment: EDh 00h (all LEDs off). For a Phoenix KBC with 04C1 bit 4 and class != 5 without the old-firmware flag: command CBh (KBC low-power mode, best guess).

31AC.name: kbc_resume_restore
31AC.comment: KeyboardPMSR restore phase (dev_resume_list). Progress words DC00:0585/0587/0589. Steps: kbc_self_test_and_disable, kbc_restore_output_port, kbc_restore_ext_ram_80_FF, kbc_restore_ram_regs_list, kbc_restore_ram_bytes, kbc_restore_B8_value, kbd_reset_retry, kbd_reset_second, mouse_reset, kbd_restore_state, mouse_restore_state, kbc_restore_password, kbc_restore_command_byte.

31EC.name: kbc_self_test_and_disable
31EC.comment: AAh self test, ADh, and A7h when an aux device exists.

324E.name: kbc_restore_ram_regs_list
324E.comment: Writes the saved RAM bytes back with command | 40h (6xh = write RAM byte n).

3274.name: kbc_restore_ram_bytes
3274.comment: kbc_ext_write_BD of the bytes listed in kbc_restore_offsets_ext / kbc_restore_offsets (offsets from 04C8).

32DE.name: kbd_reset_retry
32DE.comment: Up to 3 x (5000-tick delay, FFh reset) until FAh; 04C5 bit 5 = keyboard answered; with an aux device F5h to the mouse; drains the output buffer.

333E.name: kbd_reset_second
333E.comment: Second FFh: accepts FEh, AAh or FAh (+BAT byte), then F5h and ADh.

338D.name: mouse_reset
338D.comment: FFh via mouse_cmd, accepts 00/AAh/FAh sequences, F5h, then A7h.

33F4.name: kbd_restore_state
33F4.comment: kbd_set_leds, kbd_set_scancode_set, kbd_set_typematic, kbd_enable_or_disable, then ADh.

3416.name: kbd_set_leds
3416.comment: EDh + LED bits (saved 04D0 & 7 with extended RAM, else 04C5 & 7).

3497.name: kbd_enable_or_disable
3497.comment: F4h enable, or F5h when 04D0 bit 7 says scanning was disabled.

34C0.name: mouse_restore_state
34C0.comment: When the status was saved: mouse_set_stream_or_remote, mouse_set_scaling, mouse_set_resolution, mouse_set_sample_rate, mouse_enable_or_disable, mouse_set_wrap_mode; then A7h.

34F4.name: mouse_set_stream_or_remote
34F4.comment: F0h remote mode when status byte bit 6, else EAh stream mode.

350D.name: mouse_set_scaling
350D.comment: E7h (2:1) when status bit 4, else E6h (1:1).

3537.name: mouse_set_sample_rate
3537.comment: F3h 0Ah, F3h 3Ch, then F3h + saved rate (04DE).

355C.name: mouse_enable_or_disable
355C.comment: F4h when status bit 5 (reporting enabled), else F5h.

358C.name: kbc_restore_password
358C.comment: A5h (load password) followed by the NUL-terminated bytes from 04DF; then A6h (enable password) - or CCh when 04C1 bit 5 and 04D8 bit 1 - if 04C9 bit 3.

3619.name: mouse_cmd
3619.comment: D4h then AH to the aux device; AL = reply byte.

362B.name: kbc_ext_read_BA
362B.comment: B8h + AH (set extended RAM index), BAh -> AL.

36A9.name: kbc_flush_output
36A9.comment: Read 60h while 64h bit 0 is set; then wait for bit 1 clear.

36CE.name: kbc_read_timeout
36CE.comment: Wait up to CX refresh ticks for 64h bit 0; CF=0 AL = 60h, CF=1 AL=0 on timeout.

13A4.name: smm_setup
13A4.comment: dev_init_list member, POST 66h. CR0 |= CD|NW, INVD; chipset reg 2 |= 103h, reg 2 &= ~13h, reg 1 |= 103h open the SMRAM window (6000:8000 and 3000:8000 alias the same RAM; SMBASE starts at 30000h so the SMI entry is 3000:8000); writes a far jmp to smi_handler_first there; reg 1 |= F0h (SMI enable, best guess) and reg 6 bit 12 (software SMI trigger) fire two SMIs until the handler has cleared the jmp byte; POST 88h. Afterwards SMBASE = 60000h and the state-save template for std_rsm_cpu_reset lies at 6000:9000.

1477.name: smi_handler_first
1477.comment: Runs in SMM after the first software SMI: 3000:8000 := 0 (acknowledge), state-save SMBASE slot (3000:FEF8) := 60000h, plants a far jmp to smi_handler_second at 6000:8000, RSM.

14A2.name: smi_handler_second
14A2.comment: Second SMI, now at SMBASE 60000h: acknowledge, plant far jmp to smi_handler_runtime, copy the 512-byte SMM state-save area 6000:FE00-FFFF to 6000:9000 (template reused by std_rsm_cpu_reset), patch its CS slot (91ACh = save-area FFACh) with E800, RSM.

14D7.name: smi_handler_runtime
14D7.comment: Runtime SMI handler (power-management events): INVD, CR0 cache off, DS=ES=DC00, SS:SP=6000:FD00; unless 40:B6 bit 7 (SMI handling inhibited) is set: open private RAM, pm_state_run (pm_state_dispatch on the event code), bda_B9_bit7_set, close; INVD; RSM.

099B.name: bda_B6_bit7_test
099B.comment: ZF when 40:B6 bit 7 is clear. Bit 7 = power-management SMI handling inhibited (set by pm_smi_inhibit_set around the SETUP pop-up); smi_handler_runtime skips pm_state_run while it is set.

4F5E.name: std_rsm_cpu_reset
4F5E.comment: CPU reset through RSM: with the SMRAM window open (chipset reg 103h bit 0 cleared) check the far jmp at 6000:8000; copy the SMM state template 6000:9000-91FF to 6000:FE00 with EIP slot (91F0h = FFF0h) := 49AFh (the instruction after the call in std_save_to_disk), chipset reg 6 := 4FFFh, reg 0 := 0, reg 1 := 20F7h, POST 99h, RSM -> execution continues at E800:49AF in a clean real-mode state. Returns AX=0 without resetting when the SMI handler is not installed.

20CE.name: video_index_regs_snapshot
20CE.comment: GC 0Ah := ECh (C&T extension unlock), reads GC index 92h -> DC00:0117, 80h -> 0116, and the index ports 3D4h/3CEh/3C4h -> 0113/0114/0115.

206C.name: speaker_beep
206C.comment: Chipset reg 0 &= 88h (timers off), then toggles the speaker bit (61h bit 1) 500 times with 500-loop delays - the suspend/resume beep; restores reg 0.

20AF.name: speaker_beep_n
20AF.comment: AL beeps: speaker_beep, then a delay of 500*2 loops between beeps.

4921.name: std_post_check
4921.comment: dev_init_list-time check run from miser_post_hook (173A) on the private stack: POST 50h; if CMOS 0Eh bit 6 (fixed-disk failure) is clear: POST 51h, DC00:0C24 := CMOS 4Ch bit 4 (a save-to-disk image is pending); when set, POST D1h and the CMOS bit is cleared again (one-shot) but 0C24 keeps it for std_resume_from_disk. POST D3h.

497F.name: std_save_to_disk
497F.comment: Save-to-disk suspend, called from enter_suspend (2459) when DC00:0C24 = 1. Private stack DF80:07FF, chipset reg 200h |= 1C00h, std_rsm_cpu_reset, then: std_save_ivt_2k, video_index_regs_snapshot, std_detect_pic_vector_bases (POST 22h), save_int6d_to_ss10, vesa_save_state, std_save_dma_page_regs, std_save_chipset_regs, std_save_records, std_save_kbc_output_port, fpu_save_if_present, port61_save, speaker_off, cmos41_bit3_save, std_seek_0, std_save_video_memory, video_set_mode_3, std_draw_saving_box; stage 0 writes base RAM 0000-9FFFF (10 x 64 KB), stage 3 writes C0000-FFFFF (4 x 64 KB), stage 1 writes extended memory in 512 KB chunks copied down to 1000:0000 in unreal mode (std_memory_size, enter_unreal_mode, std_next_chunk), stage 2 writes the 64 KB SMRAM at 6000:0000; std_draw_done_box; CMOS 58h bit 7 := 1 (image valid - the system BIOS reads the same bit as Quick Boot), checksum, chipset reg 0Eh, hd_suspend_standby, speaker_beep, regs 200h/207h := 80h (private RAM stays open), port 8Dh := 1234h (resume magic), reg 7 |= 18h, reg 1 |= AF00h, HLT.

4B6D.name: std_resume_from_disk
4B6D.comment: Called from miser_post_hook (1741): needs DC00:0C24 = 1, CMOS 0Eh bit 6 clear and CMOS 58h bit 7 set (cmos58_bit7_read); clears the bit, pic_mask_all, DF80:0030 := 1 (resumed_from_disk_flag), chipset reg 0Dh := 0, std_draw_restoring_box, then reads the image back in the reverse order (extended memory at sector 900h, SMRAM, base RAM at 200h, C0000-FFFFF at 700h skipping the 2 KB of private stack at DF80:0000, video memory at 0), std_restore_video_memory, cmos41_bit3_restore, port61_restore, fpu_restore_if_present, vesa_restore_state, std_restore_chipset_regs, std_restore_kbc_output_port, std_restore_ivt_2k, std_restore_dma_page_regs, std_restore_records, sub_210B, jmp resume_entry.

4820.name: std_header_sectors
4820.comment: AX = 100h: the image starts 200h sectors (2 x 100h) after the video-memory area - i.e. base RAM begins at sector 200h.

4824.name: kbc_enable_a20
4824.comment: Output port D0h/D1h with bit 1 set.

48B1.name: std_save_records
48B1.comment: 13 record values via pm_record_service AH=1 -> DC00:0C0A.. (word each), re-opening the private RAM (reg 207h bit 7) after every call.

48E9.name: std_restore_records
48E9.comment: pm_record_service AH=3 for the 13 saved record values.

4742.name: vesa_save_state
4742.comment: INT 10h AX=4F04h DL=1 CX=0Fh ES:BX=DC00:0609 (VESA save state); if unsupported INT 10h AX=1C01h CX=7 (VGA save state) through the video BIOS vector.

476E.name: vesa_restore_state
476E.comment: INT 10h AX=4F04h DL=2 (or AX=1C02h) from DC00:0609.

479A.name: std_save_video_memory
479A.comment: INT 10h mode 90h (mode 10h without clearing memory), ATC index 0 (screen off), then for planes 3..0: GC 04h (read map select) := plane and std_write_sectors of A000:0000, 64 KB each -> 256 KB at sectors 0-1FFh.

47CB.name: std_restore_video_memory
47CB.comment: INT 10h mode 10h, ATC off, for planes 8,4,2,1: sequencer 02h (map mask) := plane and std_read_sectors into A000:0000.

4802.name: video_set_mode_3
4802.comment: INT 10h AX=0003h via the saved video BIOS vector.

480B.name: save_int6d_to_ss10
480B.comment: IVT 6Dh (video BIOS INT 10h entry) -> SS:0010 for chain_prev_vector_ss10.

4D8C.name: std_restore_ivt_2k
4D8C.comment: DC00:0C25 -> 0000:0000 (2 KB: IVT and first BDA half).

4FD4.name: enter_unreal_mode
4FD4.comment: Builds a 2-entry GDT at SS:0031 (descriptor 08h = 4 GB data, base 0), LGDT, CR0.PE on, loads DS/ES with selector 08h, CR0.PE off (limits stay 4 GB), far jump back, LIDT of the real-mode IVT (limit 3FFh). Lets rep movsd with ESI/EDI reach extended memory.

5052.name: unreal_gdt_template
5052.comment: 16 bytes: null descriptor + 4 GB data descriptor (FFFF 0000 00 92 8F 00).

5068.name: std_next_chunk
5068.comment: Remaining byte count at SS:002A: takes min(remaining, 80000h) as the next chunk, SS:002E := chunk/64 KB, ECX := chunk/4 (dwords); ECX=0 when done.

50E2.name: std_restore_chipset_regs
50E2.comment: Writes the 15 saved words back to the registers of std_chipset_reg_list.

5144.name: std_chipset_reg_list
5144.comment: 15 chipset register indexes saved across save-to-disk, FFFF end.

5100.name: std_save_dma_page_regs
5100.comment: DMA page registers 80h-8Fh -> DC00:1447 (16 bytes); then rewrites 81h-8Ch from the chipset shadow registers 201h-206h (std_dma_shadow_list) so the shadows and the hardware agree.

5164.name: std_dma_shadow_list
5164.comment: Chipset registers 201h-206h: shadow copies of DMA page registers.

5172.name: std_memory_size
5172.comment: Scans chipset bank registers 203h-206h: for each with bit 8 set, bits 0-5 = bank size code; keeps the largest (SS:0047/0048); bits 6-7 -> table 5203 (1,2,4,16) added; result << 4 = total memory in 64 KB units; SS:002A/002C := total bytes above 1 MB; AX = number of 512 KB chunks (0 = no extended memory).

5207.name: chipset86_cmos14_snapshot
5207.comment: Chipset reg 86h low byte -> DC00:1457; reads CMOS 14h.

521E.name: std_detect_pic_vector_bases
521E.comment: POST 22h. Saves the IVT (1 KB) to DC00:0C25 and 5000:8000 (34h bytes) to 145E, installs the stub at 532B at 5000:8000 and points all 256 vectors at it with CS = 5000h+n (so the stub learns the vector number from CS); unmasks IRQ0 only and waits for a tick (DC00:1459, vector -> 145A), then IRQ8 only with the RTC periodic interrupt (CMOS 0Ah rate 3, 0Bh PIE) and waits (1458, vector -> 145B); restores CMOS 0Ah/0Bh, the IVT and 5000:8000. Result: the interrupt vector numbers the OS uses for IRQ0 and IRQ8.

532B.name: std_vector_probe_stub
532B.comment: Copied to 5000:8000: push ax; POST 77h; first call sets DC00:1459 := 1 and 145A := CS low byte, later ones 1458 := 1 and 145B := CS low byte; EOI to both PICs; iret.

535F.name: pic_init_std
535F.comment: ICW1 15h, ICW2 70h/08h, ICW3 02h/04h, ICW4 01h on both PICs, then pic_mask_all - the interrupt setup used while the image is written or read.

556C.name: fpu_restore_if_present
556C.comment: If DC00:1492 bit 1: port F0h (clear busy), FRSTOR from DC00:1494.

559D.name: cmos_write_field_dx
559D.comment: DL = CMOS index, DH = mask, AL = field value: read-modify-write of the field.

55D1.name: cmos_ext_checksum_update
55D1.comment: Sums CMOS 40h-7Dh and stores the word at 7Eh/7Fh (Phoenix extended-CMOS checksum).

5622.name: cmos41_bit3_restore
5622.comment: Writes the saved bit back and updates the extended checksum.

5633.name: cmos58_bit7_read
5633.comment: AL = CMOS 58h bit 7: set by std_save_to_disk when an image is on disk (the system BIOS reads the same bit as 'Quick Boot' and skips the POST tests).

564A.name: std_disk_setup
564A.comment: IVT 13h := F000:E3FE (ROM INT 13h entry), IVT 15h := F000:F859, IVT 76h := std_int76_stub; pic_init_std; std_find_partition (std_fatal on error); std_space_map_reverse.

5BA0.name: std_int76_stub
5BA0.comment: IRQ14 handler during save/restore: 40:8E := FFh (disk interrupt flag), EOI both PICs, iret.

5900.name: std_find_save2dsk_file
5900.comment: Scans 16 x 32-byte FAT directory entries at DS:BX for the name 'SAVE2DSKBIN' (SAVE2DSK.BIN): on a match the start cluster (+1Ah) is converted with sectors/cluster SS:005E, root/FAT geometry SS:005F/0061/0067/0089 and added to the partition base SS:0050 - the image can live in a file on a FAT partition instead of the A0h partition.

59AD.name: std_error_delay
59AD.comment: POST code AL on port 80h, ~512 x 64K loop delay, CF=1.

59C0.name: std_read_sectors_mapped
59C0.comment: ESI = logical sector, CL = count, ES:BX = buffer: std_map_lba splits the run at space-map boundaries, INT 13h AH=02h DL=80h per piece, progress via std_progress_update unless ES = A000; error code 8 (map) / 2 (read) -> std_fatal.

5A35.name: std_write_sectors_mapped
5A35.comment: Same with INT 13h AH=03h; error codes 9 / 3.

5AAA.name: std_map_lba
5AAA.comment: Space map at SS:008D (8-byte entries: dword logical end, dword physical offset): finds the entry covering ESI, EBX = sectors left in the run, ESI := physical sector.

5B46.name: std_space_map_reverse
5B46.comment: Reverses the order of the used entries of the space map at SS:0095 (up to 3Fh entries, FFFFFFFF = unused).

5BC2.name: std_seek
5BC2.comment: SS:0290 := ECX (sector position in the image).

5BC9.name: std_read_sectors
5BC9.comment: CL sectors at the current position into ES:DI; position advanced.

5BE5.name: std_write_sectors
5BE5.comment: CL sectors from ES:DI at the current position; position advanced.

3E67.name: std_draw_saving_box
3E67.comment: std_draw_frame then the box record 3DC7 ('Saving to disk').

3E7D.name: std_show_error
3E7D.comment: AL = error code 0-9 (>= 10 -> 0): draws box record 3DEF and the message from std_error_msg_ids[AL]; prints it centred.

3EB6.name: std_draw_frame
3EB6.comment: Cursor off, attribute fill, frame records 3D9F/3DB3, the 'stage' string list 41E3 (id 30h), zeroes the six progress counters at SS:0000-000A and draws them.

3F02.name: std_fill_screen
3F02.comment: Fills the whole screen with attribute 07h (mono) / 03h from record 415E.

3F1B.name: std_set_stage
3F1B.comment: SS:0000 := AL (0 base RAM, 1 extended, 2 SMRAM, 3 upper memory).

3F20.name: std_stage_counter_offsets
3F20.comment: Word offsets 1,3,5,7 of the per-stage sector counters in SS:.

3F28.name: std_progress_update
3F28.comment: Adds CL sectors to the counter of the current stage and to the total (SS:0009); prints both with word_to_decimal_padded at the row from record 3DB3.

3F81.name: debug_flag_table
3F81.comment: 16 SMM state-save offsets (ACh CS, A0h.., 9Ch, 98h, 94h, 90h, 0Ah.., 32h, 30h, 8Ch) followed by DEBUG-style flag mnemonics: bit 0Bh 'NV/OV', 0Ah 'UP/DN', 09h 'DI/EI', 07h 'PL/NG', 06h 'NZ/ZR', 04h 'NA/AC', 02h 'PO/PE', 00h 'NC/CY'.

3FC9.name: debug_register_dump
3FC9.comment: Far-callable (RETF) register dump: pushad/pushfd, draws box record 3E17, prints the saved registers from the stack frame as hex and the flags with the DEBUG mnemonics from debug_flag_table. Development aid left in the ROM.

4081.name: fill_screen_attr
4081.comment: AH = attribute: fills rows x cols with AX.

4096.name: put_char_xy
4096.comment: Character AL at row DH col DL.

409F.name: put_attr_xy
409F.comment: Attribute AH at row DH col DL.

40AB.name: fill_words_xy
40AB.comment: CX copies of AX (char+attr) from row DH col DL.

40B8.name: put_string_attr_xy
40B8.comment: CX characters from ES:DI with attribute AH.

40CC.name: put_string_xy
40CC.comment: CX characters from ES:DI, attributes untouched.

40DE.name: fill_rect
40DE.comment: CH rows x CL columns of AX from DH/DL.

410E.name: is_color_text
410E.comment: ZF when 40:89 bit 2 is clear and the mode is 3 (colour text); used to pick the colour attribute set of a box record.

412E.name: video_addr_es_di
412E.comment: ES:DI = B800h (B000h unless mode 3) : (row DH x cols + col DL) x 2 + 40:4E.

45EE.name: alloca_es_di
45EE.comment: Allocates AX (rounded even) bytes on the caller's stack and returns ES:DI -> buffer (pops its own return address first).

45FF.name: strlen_es_di
45FF.comment: CX = length of the NUL-terminated string at ES:DI.

460F.name: count_lines_max_len
460F.comment: CX = number of NUL-terminated strings up to an empty one, BX = longest.

462B.name: strchr_es_di
462B.comment: CX = index of AL in the string at ES:DI.

463F.name: hex_byte_to_ascii
463F.comment: AL -> two hex digits + NUL at ES:DI.

465F.name: hex_word_to_ascii
465F.comment: AX -> 4 hex digits at ES:DI (hex_byte_to_ascii twice).

4682.name: byte_to_decimal
4682.comment: AH -> right-aligned decimal (2 pad chars AL) at ES:DI.

46B6.name: word_to_decimal_padded
46B6.comment: AX -> 5-character right-aligned decimal at ES:DI (pad char BL, e.g. ' ').

4705.name: find_string_record
4705.comment: ES:DI = list of (id, length, text...) records terminated by id 0: returns DI -> text of the record with id AL (CF=1 and DI past the list when missing).

4DA3.name: draw_box_record
4DA3.comment: ES:DI = box record: +0 flags (0400h/0800h position from the BDA cursor, 1000h/2000h size from the text, 4000h/8000h centre), +2 row, +3 col, +4 height, +5 width, +6..+9 mono attributes, +A..+D colour attributes, +E title string id, +10 body string id, +12 frame-character record id. Computes geometry (box_geometry), draws the frame (draw_frame_chars), the title centred on the top line and the body lines.

4E04.name: box_geometry
4E04.comment: From the record: CX = height/width (+2 for the frame, or measured from the body text), DX = row/col (centred or from the cursor), AX/BX = attributes for the current mode.

4EB7.name: draw_frame_chars
4EB7.comment: Draws corners (+0..+3), horizontal (+4/+5) and vertical (+6/+7) characters of the frame record, then clears the interior with spaces.

3D9F.name: std_box_records
3D9F.comment: Box records used by the save-to-disk screens: 3D9F/3DB3 frame + counters, 3DC7 saving, 3DDB restoring, 3DEF error, 3E03 done, 3E17 debug dump, 3E2B, 3E3F; then std_error_msg_ids at 3E53.

415E.name: std_string_records
415E.comment: String records (id, len, text) for the frames and messages: 415E frame characters, 41E3 stage names...

0550.name: setup_popup_from_smi
0550.comment: Runs SETUP from the SMI-created real-mode context (setup_context_entry): INT 15h AX=1022h BX=0 is a veto hook (a resident program answering BX!=0 blocks the pop-up); then chipset_200_207_bit2_set, pic_save_and_mask_for_popup, bda_popup_mark_set, setup_popup_run, pic_restore_masks_popup, chipset_200_207_bit2_clear.

05F7.name: setup_popup_run
05F7.comment: The pop-up SETUP sequence: kbc_cmd_A7_disable_aux, pic_save_and_mask_for_popup, port61_save_46_speaker_off, save_hooked_vectors_2, video_index_regs_snapshot, vga_state_save_c800, popup_park_video_memory, chipset_200_207_bit2_set, kbc_cmd_AE_enable_kbd, STI, lcall F000:0100 (call_system_setup), CLI, popup_restore_video_memory, vga_state_restore_c800, setup_changes_apply, install_activity_hooks, port61_restore_46, pic_restore_masks_popup, kbc_cmd_A8_enable_aux, hd_set_idle_timer.

0656.name: chipset_200_207_bit2_set
0656.comment: Chipset regs 200h and 207h |= 4 (shadow RAM write enable for the pop-up, best guess).

066F.name: chipset_200_207_bit2_clear
066F.comment: Chipset regs 200h/207h &= FBh (end of the pop-up).

06DE.name: save_hooked_vectors_2
06DE.comment: When the module is initialised (query_state_34): copies IVT 09h/16h/10h/15h/21h/33h to DC00:0028-003F (the slots the activity hooks chain to).

0825.name: pic_save_and_mask_for_popup
0825.comment: PIC masks -> DC00:0044/0045; then 21h := F9h (only IRQ1 and IRQ2), A1h := FEh (only IRQ8).

083D.name: pic_restore_masks_popup
083D.comment: PIC masks := DC00:0044/0045 saved by pic_save_and_mask_for_popup.

0859.name: vga_select_plane2_font
0859.comment: Sequencer 02h := 04h (map mask plane 2), 04h := 07h; GC 04h := 02h (read plane 2), 05h := 00h, 06h := 04h - makes the font plane visible at A000 for font_save_to_c800 / font_restore_from_c800.

0878.name: vga_state_save_c800
0878.comment: INT 10h AX=1C01h CX=8007h ES:BX=C800:0800 through the video BIOS vector: saves the video state into the hidden RAM at C800 (the pop-up SETUP uses C800:0000-4FFF as scratch).

08A4.name: font_save_to_c800
08A4.comment: Plane 2 (GC 04h := 2) glyph rows A000:0000-2010 (16 bytes of every 32) -> C800:1EA0.

0912.name: text_screen_restore_c800
0912.comment: C800:0F00 -> B800:0000 (4000 bytes): restores the text screen after the pop-up.

092C.name: setup_changes_apply
092C.comment: 40:B6 bit 6 (SETUP saved new settings) -> cleared together with bit 1; if it was set: display_device_apply, POST 4Eh, config_records_init, POST 4Fh.

0970.name: pm_smi_inhibit_set
0970.comment: 40:B6 |= 80h: smi_handler_runtime ignores power-management events while set (used around the SETUP pop-up).

0A6D.name: kbc_cmd_byte_save_set_65
0A6D.comment: Reads the KBC command byte (20h) -> DC00:0047 and writes 65h (keyboard IRQ on, aux off, translate).

0AB1.name: kbc_flush_60_slow
0AB1.comment: Drains 60h with a refresh-tick delay between reads.

0BE0.name: popup_park_video_memory
0BE0.comment: Before the pop-up SETUP: masks the PICs, saves the run-time patched disk table F000:E6B1 (64 bytes) and F000:FFEC (16 bytes) to DC00:0048/0088, screen off, chipset reg 200h := 0C8Fh and 207h |= 13BFh (shadow RAM at C000-FFFF writable), programs the sequencer/GC for planar 64 KB access and uses C&T XR0B/XR10 (bank select) to copy the four 64 KB video-memory banks into F000, D000, E000 and C000 (the RAM behind the ROM shadow), screen on, INT 10h AH=83h via the video BIOS vector.

0CB8.name: popup_restore_video_memory
0CB8.comment: After SETUP: screen off, chipset reg 200h := 1FFFh, 207h := 80h, copies the banks back from D000/E000/C000 into video memory (XR10 bank select), then re-shadows the ROM (reg 200h &= ~137Fh, reg 207h |= 1300h, copies E000->E000 and F000->F000 to refresh the shadow RAM from ROM), restores the patched disk table from DC00:0048/0088 into F000:E6B1/FFEC, reg 200h |= 1F80h, reg 207h &= ~1F7Fh, screen on.

0DC3.name: vga_screen_off_atc
0DC3.comment: Read 3DAh, ATC index := 00h (palette access, display off).

0104.name: apm_dispatch_body
0104.comment: Body of apm_dispatch (also reached from the far entries apm_dispatch_retf32 / apm_dispatch_retf): sets CF in the caller's flags for AL > 0Bh, else chipset reg 0Eh := 3E18h, open private RAM, call apm_function_table[AL], close, reg 0Eh := 3E10h.

04E5.name: apm_pm16_entry_thunk
04E5.comment: Pushes a far return to 04FB (pop si/pop ds/retf) and to apm_dispatch_retf, sets DS = CS+8 (selector arithmetic for the 16-bit protected-mode APM entry), RETF.

1297.name: sb_dsp_vendor_check
1297.comment: Sound Blaster DSP: wait write-ready, command E7h, read 22Ah; CF=0 when the reply is 48h (vendor identification of the on-board codec, best guess).

136C.name: smram_hide
136C.comment: Chipset reg 103h bit 0 := 1 (SMRAM at 6000:xxxx hidden, normal RAM visible).

137A.name: smram_expose
137A.comment: Chipset reg 103h bit 0 := 0 (SMRAM visible at 6000:xxxx for the handler set-up).

1389.name: chipset_reg10_wait_stable
1389.comment: pusha; reads chipset reg 10h until two consecutive reads agree twice; popa.

1570.name: resume_smi_reentry
1570.comment: Planted SMI handler used by resume_continue: SS:SP := 6000:8000, clears the SMI trigger, re-plants smi_handler_runtime, restores the pre-suspend SMM state (9400 -> FE00), jmp resume_finish_rsm.

248A.name: resume_finish_rsm
248A.comment: DS=DC00, SS:SP from DC00:0118/011A, POST code from 011C; DC00:028C (256 words) -> 3000:FE00 and DC00:048C (8 bytes) -> 3000:8000 (the OS-side SMM image saved at suspend), 40:72 := DC00:011F, chipset reg 1 |= ..., then RSM back into the interrupted OS context.

25C0.name: pic_init_from_detected_bases
25C0.comment: ICW1 11h, ICW2 from DC00:145A/145B (the vector bases found by std_detect_pic_vector_bases), ICW3 04h/02h, ICW4 01h, then masks all.

25EE.name: chipset_reg2_field_clear_wait
25EE.comment: POST 55h; clears reg 2 bits 0-9 and re-reads up to 300h times until they read 0.

2621.name: stub_popf
2621.comment: pushf; popf; pops and returns (no-op tail of chipset_reg2_field_clear_wait).

2627.name: dma_controllers_reinit
2627.comment: DMA1 mode 0Bh := 40h..43h (single mode, verify, channels 0-3), DMA2 mode D6h := C0h (cascade ch4), D4h := 0 (unmask). Same code as dma_ch2_reinit.

264E.name: smi_run_setup
264E.comment: SMI-time SETUP: save_pic_masks_and_mask_all, remembers the POST-code port value (DC00:011C), POST 55h, smi_rsm_to_setup_context (returns here only after SETUP has finished and the SMI has been re-entered), restore masks, pm_timer_reload, POST 56h.

266D.name: smi_rsm_to_setup_context
266D.comment: Inside SMM: saves the current SMM state 6000:FE00 -> 9200, builds a template with EIP := setup_context_entry, remembers chipset reg 86h (9600), 40:B6-B9 (9601), SS:SP (9605/9607), plants smi_stub_rsm at 6000:8000, INVD, RSM -> the CPU wakes in real mode at setup_context_entry.

26C3.name: setup_context_entry
26C3.comment: Clean real-mode context created by RSM: DS=SS=DC00, SP=4000h, smram_expose, setup_popup_from_smi (runs SETUP), smram_hide, plants smi_return_from_setup_context at 6000:8000, smram_expose, enables SMI (reg 1 F0h) and fires a software SMI (reg 6 bit 12); hangs until it arrives.

26F9.name: smi_return_from_setup_context
26F9.comment: SMI handler that ends the pop-up: SS:SP from 9605/9607 (the stack smi_rsm_to_setup_context was called on), CMOS index restored, re-plants smi_handler_runtime, restores the original SMM state 9200 -> FE00 and 40:B6-B9, clears the SMI trigger, RET - which returns into smi_run_setup after its call.

274B.name: cpu_state_save_to_si
274B.comment: FNSAVE to [SI+E9h], EAX..EBP/ESP, CS/DS/ES/FS/GS/SS and CR0 into the record at DS:SI; zeroes DS/SS/ES/FS/GS and jumps to BX (the return address popped from the stack).

27A8.name: cpu_state_restore_from_si
27A8.comment: Reverse of cpu_state_save_to_si: CR0 (if protected mode was on), segment registers, ESP, general registers, FRSTOR, then RET to the popped address.

28DE.name: floppy_reset_and_sense
28DE.comment: DOR := (40:3F motor bits rotated) | 08h (reset asserted), then | 0Ch (reset released, DMA on), 10 ticks, four FDC sense-interrupt commands (fdc_sense_interrupt) to clear the reset status.

290E.name: fdc_sense_interrupt
290E.comment: Command 08h via fdc_write_cmd_byte, then 2 result bytes via fdc_read_results.

2920.name: fdc_write_cmd_byte
2920.comment: Waits for RQM (3F4h bit 7); if DIO (bit 6) says the FDC has result bytes pending, drains 16 of them and returns CF=1; else writes AL to 3F5h.

2938.name: fdc_drain_results
2938.comment: Reads 16 pending FDC result bytes (fdc_read_results CX=10h) and returns CF=1.

2943.name: fdc_read_results
2943.comment: Up to CX result bytes from 3F5h (while RQM and DIO are set) -> DC00:0498.

3A28.name: uart_clear_status
3A28.comment: Reads LSR (+5), MSR (+6) and RBR (+0) of the UART at DX to clear pending status.

3C21.name: ticks_constants
3C21.comment: 60 (minutes), 34DCh/0012h = 18.2065 ticks per second as a 16.16 fraction.

3C27.name: time_to_ticks
3C27.comment: BCD h:m:s from rtc_read_time -> seconds since midnight -> 18.2 Hz tick count in DC00:05F9 (low) / 05FB (high).

3C89.name: date_to_elapsed_days
3C89.comment: Reads the date, stores day/month/year at DC00:0603/0605/0607 and computes the number of days elapsed since the snapshot in 05FD/05FF/0601 (month table days_per_month, leap years) -> 05F8.

3CFC.name: days_left_in_month
3CFC.comment: days_per_month[BX] - CX (+1 in a leap-year February).

3D0E.name: days_in_rest_of_year
3D0E.comment: Sum of days_per_month for months BX+1..12 (+1 leap day when BX <= 2).

3D2B.name: days_between_years
3D2B.comment: 365 per year from DX to BX plus leap days.

37B0.name: crtc_unlock_reg11
37B0.comment: CRTC 11h bit 7 := 0 (write-enable CRTC 0-7) at the base in DX, index restored.

210B.name: video_index_regs_restore
210B.comment: Restores 3D4h/3CEh/3C4h index registers and GC 80h/92h from DC00:0113-0117 (GC 0Ah := ECh unlock).

1F71.name: pm_irq_reenable_tail
1F71.comment: Tail of pm_irq_reenable (falls in from the nop sled): chipset reg 12h |= 20h, POST 62h.

1A9E.name: pm_evt_system_sleep
1A9E.comment: Event 8 (System Sleep timeout): refused (loc_0E03) when a PCMCIA card is present and DC00:0110 bit 3; else chipset reg 6 |= 80h, reg 2 &= ~13FFh, reg 1 := 20F7h (CPU clock slowed), reg 6 |= 4000h, reg 11h := 200h; unless state 0110 = 3: reg 0Dh field 380h := 010C (re-arm) and 0110 := 0; lcd_panel_off.

1B07.name: pm_evt_activity_wakeup
1B07.comment: Event 5 (activity after sleep): reg 6 |= 4000h, reg 2 &= ~13FFh, reg 6 &= ~80h, reg 1 := 9FF7h or 7FF7h (full speed) depending on bits 11/12, state 0110 reset unless 3; if 0111 bit 0 (disk was spun down) re-arm the drive (reg 3 bit 1, hd_set_idle_timer); reg 10h := 1, reg 6 &= ~4000h.

1B99.name: pm_evt_standby_or_suspend_timeout
1B99.comment: Event 4: with a PCMCIA card present -> refused (loc_0E03). State 0110 = 3 or 2 -> pm_enter_suspend_state. Otherwise first stage = standby: reg 0Dh field 380h := 010D (suspend timeout), 0110 := 2, hd_set_standby_timer (reg 3 bit 1 pulsed), reg 2 &= ~13FFh, reg 6 &= ~80h, reg 1 := 77F7h, reg 11h := 100h, reg 6 &= ~4000h, reg 10h := 0, lcd_panel_on.

1C2F.name: pm_evt_fn_hotkey
1C2F.comment: Event 7 (Fn hot key reported in chipset reg 7 bits 8-10): 1 brightness up (+8 in CMOS 3Fh bits 3-7, max F0h), 5 brightness down (min 08h), 6 contrast up (bits 0-2 +1), 2 contrast down; the new byte goes to port 1FFh and CMOS 3Fh. Code 3 on battery with reg 0 bits 12-13 toggles reg 9-0Ch bit 8; codes 7/3 otherwise = volume up/down on the Sound Blaster DSP (command DEh reads the level 0-0Fh, DFh + level sets it). Acknowledges with reg 1 field F0h := 0Fh.

1E4D.name: pm_evt_lcd_dim
1E4D.comment: Event 6 (LCD Dim timeout): CMOS 3Fh with the contrast bits 0-2 cleared -> port 1FFh (panel dimmed), reg 1 |= F7h.

1E62.name: pm_evt_reinit_timeouts
1E62.comment: Event 0Ch: pm_timeouts_apply, pm_timer_reload, reg 1 |= F7h, battery-low counter DC00:000E := 0, chipset_regs9_C_bit8_set.

15A6.name: chipset_init_triples
15A6.comment: (value, mask, register) triples for run_triple_table until register FFFFh; 1612 is the sub-list used by miser_post_hook, the rest by resume/init paths.

0A05.name: popup_wait_key_ascii
0A05.comment: Waits for a make code on 60h, looks it up in popup_scancode_list (17 entries) and returns the matching ASCII from popup_ascii_list in AL (0 when unknown), AH = scancode.

0A33.name: popup_scancode_list
0A33.comment: 17 scancodes: 02h-0Bh (1..0), 0Eh Backspace, 4Eh keypad +, 4Ah keypad -, 01h Esc, 39h Space, 0Dh =, 0Ch -.

0A44.name: popup_ascii_list
0A44.comment: '1234567890', 08h, '+', '-', 1Bh, ' ', '=', '-' (parallel to popup_scancode_list); followed by a second scancode/character pair list (48h/4Bh/4Dh/50h cursor keys, 3Eh-40h F4-F6, 45h, 52h Ins, 53h Del ...) for another key map.

0E03.name: pm_card_present_toggle
0E03.comment: Reached instead of sleeping/suspending while a PCMCIA card is inserted (from pm_evt_system_sleep, pm_evt_standby_or_suspend_timeout and enter_suspend): toggles DC00:0110 bit 3. Entering: reg 3 |= 3, hd_set_standby_timer, lcd_panel_on, reg 2 &= ~13FFh, reg 11h := 100h, reg 10h := 0, reg 6 := 303h, reg 0Dh := 800h (timeouts off), reg 1 |= F7h. Leaving: reg 11h := 200h, reg 2 &= ~13FFh, reg 6 := 4383h, reg 3 := 2EC0h (+bit 0 when stub_clc says so), reg 1 |= F7h, lcd_panel_off, pm_timeouts_apply.

04CD.name: jmp_enter_suspend
04CD.comment: jmp enter_suspend (near thunk used by pm_enter_suspend_state).

2EFA.name: kbc_read_version_config_tail
2EFA.comment: Second half of kbc_read_version_config (D6h/D8h: two config bytes -> 04C1/04C2).

35F5.name: kbc_restore_password_send
35F5.comment: Tail of kbc_restore_password: sends the A6h/CCh command.

04BD.name: pm_request_event_bit0
04BD.comment: If DC00:000C bit 7 (PM enabled): set event bit 0 (standby request) in DC00:000C.

0789.name: install_popup_int16
0789.comment: When 40:B6 bit 1 (pop-up SETUP active): IVT 16h := E800:popup_int16_service - SETUP's keyboard service inside the SMI context.

3772.name: video_ext_12_92_from_9A
